generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero planned effort exceeding available capacity without an escalated gap
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate the resourcing gap or descope discretionary work explicitly
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Mandatory and discretionary work with person-week estimates totalled against capacity
generic.Evidence location: PPM tool work plan baseline published on Microsoft 365 SharePoint

steps.title: List the mandatory cycle work in the PPM tool
sop: List valuations, opinion, statutory and GAAP reporting, capital and ORSA support
Attach the driving deadline to each item
Mark each as mandatory
Done when every mandatory item is listed with its deadline
verify: Compare the mandatory list to the valuation calendar deadlines
Pass when every calendar deadline has a mandatory work item

steps.title: Add the discretionary work items
sop: Add methodology reviews, model rebuilds, automation and pricing support
State the benefit each item targets
Mark each as discretionary
Done when the discretionary items are listed with their benefits
verify: Check each discretionary item for a stated benefit
Pass when every discretionary item states a benefit

steps.title: Estimate effort in person-weeks per item in Microsoft Excel
sop: Estimate effort in person-weeks for every item
Base estimates on actual effort from prior cycles where available
Record the basis for each estimate
Done when every item carries a person-week estimate with a basis
verify: Compare two estimates to prior-cycle actuals
Pass when every estimate states a basis

steps.title: Total the effort against available capacity
sop: Total planned effort and compare to available capacity not headcount
Net off leave, study days and known absences
Escalate any shortfall as a resourcing gap
Done when planned effort is totalled against available capacity
verify: Recompute the capacity calculation
Pass when no planned effort exceeds capacity without an escalated gap

steps.title: Sequence the discretionary work around the valuation peaks
sop: Schedule discretionary work outside the valuation peak weeks
Confirm the sequence is deliverable within the capacity profile
Record the sequencing decisions
Done when discretionary work is sequenced away from the peaks
verify: Compare the sequence to the valuation calendar peaks
Pass when no discretionary item is scheduled inside a peak week

steps.title: Obtain Chief Actuary approval and publish the plan as baseline
sop: Review the plan for deliverability and mandatory coverage
Record the approval decision and date
Publish the plan as the baseline for progress tracking
Done when the approved plan is published as the baseline
verify: Open the published plan and check the baseline label
Pass when the published plan matches the approved version
